name: odin-test-explorer
description: Discover and run Odin @(test) procedures directly in VS Code's Test Explorer.

odinTestExplorer.odinPath.description: Path to the Odin compiler executable.

odinTestExplorer.trackMemory.description: Enable Odin's built-in test runner memory tracking (ODIN_TEST_TRACK_MEMORY).

odinTestExplorer.extraArgs.description: Additional CLI arguments passed to `odin test` (e.g., ["-collection:shared=src/shared"]).

odinTestExplorer.debuggerType.description: VS Code debug adapter type used to launch tests from the Debug profile (for example, lldb or cppdbg).
